key: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
s: With the northern kings routed and everyone in their cities killed, the chapter sums up the war; Rashi, on 11:18, reads it as told to Joshua’s discredit: since he was to apportion the land, he meant to delay its conquest and lengthen his days.

evidence.gloss: Many days did Joshua make: Scripture tells this to his discredit, that he intended to put off the conquest of the land in order to lengthen his days, because it was said (above, 1:10): ‘and you shall apportion it to them’; in the Midrash Tanchuma.
